clauses.clause: Live damage at cellar entry: ≥ 4 fires, ≥ 2 burning vehicles, ≥ 10 shattered windows, ≥ 6 scorch decals.
clauses.note: Both actual cellar-entry renderer routes:4 live long-duration fires,3 burning/exploded vehicle wrecks,10 shattered windows; actual renderer scorch pool21 low/20 high (required6). Untouched ordinary mortal ledger separately confirms4/3/10. Production L4 fire duration3600 seconds keeps these fires alive at entry; VehicleView draws fire for burning OR exploded, so exploded wrecks are not excluded incorrectly. Renderer route protects only courier, NPCs remain mortal; no forced damage counts or objective advance.
